dct_description_sm:
This dataset includes all types of water valves with in the City's distribution system, includes main valves and service curb stops as well as special operating valves for controlling the system, such as back flow prevention, air release, drain,etc.

Please be advised that these records are based upon available information, compiled from a variety of sources, some of which has not been verified. This is not a plan of survey, field verification is recommended.
